applicationStart: cd /root/code_deploy_application && npm install --no-audit --no-fund && { PORT=8000 nohup node examples/hello-world/index.js >> /root/application.log 2>&1 & APP_PID=$!; echo "$APP_PID" > /root/application.pid; sleep 2; kill -0 "$APP_PID"; } && { ready=0; for i in $(seq 1 30); do code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://127.0.0.1:8000/ || echo 000); if [ "$code" -ge 200 ] && [ "$code" -lt 400 ]; then ready=1; break; fi; sleep 2; done; [ "$ready" = "1" ]; }
applicationStop: if [ -f /root/application.pid ]; then PID=$(cat /root/application.pid); kill "$PID" 2>/dev/null; rm -f /root/application.pid; fi
